limitations_and_boundaries: The study uses only BMP4 as the differentiation cue; other pathways (Activin-Nodal, WNT) are not directly tested as initiators.
Micropatterned colonies are 2D approximations of the 3D embryo; 3D culture systems were not explored.
siRNA knockdowns are transient and may not achieve complete loss of function.
The PDMS microwell experiments used wells of 250 µm diameter and depth, which may not capture all diffusion dynamics.
The study focuses on early germ layer patterning and does not address later differentiation stages or organogenesis.
The results are based on a limited number of hESC lines (RUES2, RUES1, H1) and may not generalize to all pluripotent stem cell lines.
The selected source chunks do not report a rescue, reconstitution, reversal, or epistasis experiment; that rung of the causal evidence chain remains untested within this extraction scope.

research_questions.statement: Can geometric confinement trigger self-organized spatial patterning of germ layers in hESCs?

provenance.text_excerpt: We show that geometric confinement is sufficient to trigger self-organized patterning in hESCs.

claims.statement: Geometric confinement is sufficient to trigger self-organized patterning in hESCs.

experiments_or_tasks: hESCs were confined to circular micropatterns and differentiated with BMP4 to observe spatial ordering of germ layers.

methods.name: Micropatterned cell culture
methods.protocol_description: hESCs were seeded onto micropatterned glass coverslips coated with poly(d-lysine) and Matrigel. Cells were pretreated with Rock-inhibitor Y27632 (10 µM) for 1 h, dissociated with trypsin, and 5 × 10^5 cells were resuspended in 2.5 ml growth medium containing Rock-I and placed over the coverslip. After 2 h, medium was replaced with MEF-CM without Rock-I and incubated overnight. Differentiation was induced with BMP4.

methods.name: Immunofluorescence
methods.protocol_description: Cells were fixed with 4% paraformaldehyde, blocked and permeabilized with 3% donkey serum and 0.1% Triton X-100, incubated with primary antibodies overnight at 4°C, washed, incubated with Alexa-conjugated secondary antibodies (1:500) and DAPI, and mounted with Fluoromount-G.

methods.name: siRNA transfection
methods.protocol_description: Cells were passaged as single cells in Rock-I into 35-mm dishes at 200,000 cells per dish. The next day, cells were transfected with siRNA (Ambion Silencer Select) using RNAiMax (Invitrogen) at a final siRNA concentration of 20 nM and 2.5 µl RNAiMax per dish. The following day, cells were seeded onto micropatterned coverslips and differentiation experiments were performed.

experiments_or_tasks: hESCs were grown at the bottom of PDMS microwells to block diffusion out of the colony, and differentiation with BMP4 was assessed.

methods.name: PDMS microwell culture
methods.protocol_description: PDMS wells of controlled diameter and depth were created using 3D-printed molds. Wells were coated with cell adhesion–promoting proteins (Laminin-521 or PDL/Matrigel). Cells were seeded into wells and differentiated with BMP4.

methods.name: Immunofluorescence
